label: preparing
what: A surprise great-hall tribute for the mayor's forty years of service, disguised as an 18:00 lighting inspection, with bread and lighting arrangements. Secretary has disclosed the surprise privately and is coordinating attendance and a proposed loan for seventy-two extra loaves. Innkeeper arranges hospitality, Freight delivered bread and collected grain, and Builder arranged the inspection pretext and lighting. Watchman knowingly accommodates the approved hospitality gathering, though his knowledge of the surprise itself is uncertain.
